results.title: Democrats Lead Republicans on Key Issues Before Midterms
results.description: Democrats have erased the Republican Party's advantage on immigration and opened double-digit leads on healthcare, inflation and the cost of living less than three weeks before the midterm elections, according to a new ABC News/Washington Post/Ipsos poll.

results.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu in close Israeli election
results.description: WASHINGTON/TEL AVIV >> President Donald Trump on Sunday endorsed his ally Benjamin Netanyahu as the longtime Israeli prime minister struggles for an edge in next week’s parliamentary election.
